results.title: Pieter Abbeel - Wikipedia
results.content: **Pieter Abbeel** (born 1977) is a professor of electrical engineering and computer sciences, Director of the Berkeley Robot Learning Lab, and co-director of the Berkeley AI Research (BAIR) Lab at the University of California, Berkeley. Upon his arrival at UC Berkeley as an assistant professor, Abbeel founded the Berkeley Robot Learning Lab. Additionally, in 2014, he co-founded Gradescope with other UC Berkeley-affiliated engineers Arjun Singh, Sergey Karayev, Ibrahim Awwal, which was acquired by TurnItIn in 2018. Also in 2016, he became co-director of the Berkeley Artificial Intelligence Research (BAIR) Lab, which consists of post-doctoral, graduate, and undergraduate students interested in machine learning and robotics. Currently, in addition to his research, Abbeel teaches upper-division and graduate classes on Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, and Deep Unsupervised Learning. Abbeel joined Amazon "Amazon (company)") in August 2024, when it agreed to license Covariant's robotics foundation models and hire the company's founders. "Amazon hires the founders of AI robotics startup Covariant".

results.title: Pieter Abbeel, Keynote Speaker l nexxworks
results.content: As Co-Director of the Berkeley AI Research lab, he has made pioneering research and education contributions in deep reinforcement learning, generative AI, deep unsupervised learning, and robotics. As founder of Gradescope and Covariant, he has brought AI advances into real-world practice in education and robotic automation respectively. As Founder and Host of The Robot Brains podcast, he explores what AI and Robotics can do today and where they are headed, through conversations with his friends and colleagues AI pioneers. Pieter Abbeel is Professor and Director of the Robot Learning Lab at UC Berkeley, Co-Director of the Berkeley AI Research (BAIR) Lab, Co-Founder of Covariant [2017- ], Co-Founder of Gradescope [2014-2018, acquired by Turnitin], Advisor/Investor to many AI/Robotics start-ups, Founding Investment Partner at AIX Ventures, Host of The Robot Brains Podcast. Abbeel’s lab at Berkeley is one of the world-leading labs for machine learning and robotics.
